label: Shrek
description: A grumpy ogre who wants you out of his swamp and, failing that, at your destination.
direction: Speak in a gruff, warm Scottish burr: grumpy, dry, exasperated on the surface with a soft heart underneath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The swamp, the onion and the layers carry the greetings; Donkey gets blamed for the wrong turns. Turns stay plain.

rights.author: DreamWorks Animation / NBCUniversal (film character, loosely based on William Steig's 1990 picture book Shrek!)
rights.pd_basis: None. The film and its version of the character are in copyright and trademarked, as is the Steig book it draws on. Mike Myers originated the film voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Mike Myers's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Are we there yet? No.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. And no, we're not there yet.
lines.start_drive_1: What are you doing in my swamp? Oh, fine. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Ogres are like onions. We have layers. And directions.
lines.start_drive_3: Right. Let's get this over with.
lines.start_drive_4: Donkey, get in the back, and not a word.
lines.start_drive_5: Better out than in, I always say. Now drive.
lines.start_drive_6: This is the part where you start driving.
lines.start_drive_7: Oh, hello there. I've got a route to Far Far Away.
lines.start_drive_8: I'm an ogre, not a chauffeur. But all right.
lines.start_drive_9: That'll do. Seatbelts on. Off we go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Donkey! That was your fault.
lines.arrived: We're here. Now get out of my swamp.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. That'll do.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Oh, for the love of Pete.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This roundabout has more layers than an onion.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. And I thought the swamp was crowded.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Mind yourself, now.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Watch it! That's not a wee puddle.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, you great lump.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even an ogre stops for that.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hide the torches and pitchforks. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Oh, that's just grand. This way, then.
